source_provenance.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: ONE focused ACTION COHORT ATLAS for an original Heroes of Might and Magic III Noxus creature. Image1 is the actual own painted identity master: preserve its exact species, material, head crest, collar/binding, claws, torn mantle and thorn-vine wing construction in every frame. Image2 is a coarse current flight-v2 technical reference ONLY for action count/ground clearance/camera concept, NOT identity, robot shapes, art or body construction; follow the detailed action below when its tiny wing changes are too weak. Paint all poses organically from Image1. Original HeroesIII1999 matte painted/prerendered fantasy material language, upper-left light, compact realistic anatomy, rich charcoal hide/iron chain/brown thorns and restrained crimson cracks, no glossy3D, anime, pixel filter or League splash-art. Fixed shallow three-quarter battle camera, creature faces RIGHT except explicit turn action. The same head/torso/limb lengths and chain pattern throughout, no growing/shrinking or shuffled anatomy. Each pose WHOLE and ISOLATED with full wing fans, claws and feet inside its OWN large cell and at least12% empty gutter; no touching neighboring figures or image border. Every figure must be LARGE and detailed, around350-500px body height at a1024px-wide image, not90px miniatures or a huge all-action sheet. Use genuinely transparent alpha outside figures and through wing gaps: no scenery, floor, drop shadows, brown haze, colored background, text, labels, numbers, grid lines, border, logos, particles, smoke or glow halo. One subject per cell.  Layout: TWO columns by 4 rows, reading left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Portrait canvas ratio 1:2, approximately1536x3072, evenly sized large cells. Keep every full figure within the central75%width and75%height of its cell. Draw exactly 8 poses, no extra figures. ACTION TRAVEL FLIGHT LOOP: Exactly EIGHT sequential active flight phases: 1 both thorn-wing fans high and open; 2 starting powerful downstroke; 3 wings nearly horizontal; 4 downstroke below shoulders; 5 low folded recovery; 6 fans sweeping back upward; 7 high partly folded recovery; 8 opening back toward first pose. Long claws held forward and legs swept/dangling in true travel flight, never walking or standing. Real visibly changing wing angles and chain tension, with stable head/torso size and small flight bob. Identity variant: BASE narrow single-brow head, plain thin collar, one open chest chain and incomplete thorn wing bindings.
